title: Hospitality & Family Room Volunteer
organization: Ronald McDonald House Charities of Southern Arizona, Inc.
hours_note: Can commit to at least one 3-hour shift per week for at least the next six months
schedule_flexibility: Days and times flexible based on volunteer and House needs
description: Family rooms, kitchens, greeting guests, preparing food, light housekeeping, clerical tasks, fundraising events.
requirements: Age 16+, ability to serve physically, pass criminal background check, orientation and training provided

title: Hospital Volunteer
organization: Banner University Medical Center Tucson (Banner Health)
location: 37000 North Gantzel Road, Queen Creek, AZ 85140
hours_note: One 4-hour shift per week; commitment of at least 100 volunteer hours or 6 months service
schedule_flexibility: Shift availability varies; front office position, answer phone, greet visitors, assist staff
description: Assist hospital staff providing comfort and care to patients; support patients' positive experience and positive interactions.
requirements: Minimum age 16; complete minimum 2 hours/week or 100 hours/6 months; background check, orientation, training.

title: Grief Support Group Facilitator
hours_note: Six-month commitment for four hours per week (about 100 hours total)
schedule_flexibility: Support groups Monday-Thursday nights, 6–9 pm; twice monthly in person
description: Facilitate grief-support groups for children, teens, young adults and families; one-on-one counseling, group sessions, phone consultations.
requirements: Age 16+, background check, training provided, reliable transportation for patient visits

title: Hospice Companion Volunteer
hours_note: Typically serve 1 hour per week in providing companionship to those in final stages of life
schedule_flexibility: Volunteer schedules are flexible and vary by location; many choose a consistent weekly or monthly schedule
description: Provide companionship and emotional support to hospice patients and families during end-of-life care; sit with patients, read aloud, assist caregivers, respite care.
requirements: Age 18+, background check, orientation, willingness to work hard

title: Foster Grandparent Program Volunteer
organization: AmeriCorps Seniors – Foster Grandparent Program (Tucson area)
hours_note: Average 20 hours per week mentoring/tutoring to students with special/exceptional needs; 14 million hours collectively
schedule_flexibility: In-person schools, Head Starts, correctional institutions, childcare centers; ongoing academic year
description: Mentor/guide children and youth with special or exceptional needs through one-on-one tutoring, mentoring and social-emotional support; review schoolwork, reinforce values.
requirements: Age 55+, limited income, background check, training, no prior experience required

title: Senior Companion Program Volunteer
organization: AmeriCorps Seniors – Senior Companion Program (Tucson area)
hours_note: Be able to serve 20 hours of service each week with clients (schools, early education, childcare centers, community centers)
schedule_flexibility: In-person visits at schools, head starts, correctional institutions, community centers; weekly recurring
description: Provide one-on-one mentoring, tutoring and social-emotional support to children/youth with special or exceptional needs; meet weekly for 20 hrs.
requirements: Age 55+, income guidelines, background check, training, 8-40 hrs/week with clients, 2.5 hrs/month meeting

title: Caring Caller (Caring Calls Phone Connections)
hours_note: Weekly friendly phone conversations about 20-30 minutes; initial 8-week commitment, option to extend
schedule_flexibility: Weekly calls by phone; volunteers choose their own schedule and service area
description: Weekly phone call connections for older adults — share stories, interests, memories; 20-30 min calls.
requirements: Adults 18+, willing to talk, background check, training provided
